attorneys: Petitioner pro se. Richard W. Ervin, Attorney General of Florida, and B. Clarke Nichols, Assistant Attorney General, for respondent.

opinions.text: Motion for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Motion for leave to file petition for writ of habeas corpus denied. Treating the papers submitted as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari to the Supreme Court of Florida granted. Case transferred to the appellate docket.
